contexts.text: A thousand of silver () = an infinite abundance of rational truth... A thousand = much, and countless; here, infinite or infinite abundance, because predicated of the Lord. AC 2575:2, Illustrated.
A thousand years = what is without time, thus eternity. Illustrated.
As a thousand is a definite number, it appears in the propheticals... that a thousand means a thousand, when yet it means many or countless without any fixed number.
Be thou for a thousand of myriads () = fructification to infinity.
A thousand = much, and also what is infinite.
Thousands = things innumerable, or all these things.
A thousand flee at the presence of one who is in truth from good.
Princes of thousands () = the primary things which are in the first degree; for thousand = many people, or, in the abstract, many things...
Here () by a thousand are not signified a thousand, but much without any number. Illustrated.
Showing mercy to thousands () = good and truth for them in perpetuity. A thousand = for the most part; and, when said of the Divine mercy, in perpetuity.
Thousands and thousands of arcana.
A thousand, when predicated of the Divine, = what is infinite.
Showing goodness to thousands () = to eternity.
A thousand enemies cannot endure one ray of the light of Heaven.
Many thousands enter Heaven and Hell every day.
A thousand times exceeds...
Bound him a thousand years () = ... no communication with them for a while, or for sometime. (Fully quoted under Number.) AR 844. AR 850.
They lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years () = who are already in conjunction with the Lord, and have been for some time in His Kingdom... A thousand years = for some time. AR 855.
When the thousand years have been consummated () = after those who had hitherto been kept concealed and guarded in the Lower Earth have been taken up into Heaven by the Lord. Explained.
600 out of a thousand in favour of nature, and the rest in favour of God...
On the thousand years. Explained. SE 5372:end.
A thousand vines for a thousand of silver () = truths from good in abundance (which are) most highly esteemed, because they are genuine. A thousand = many things, thus in abundance.
Under Number, see this reference.
Ten, a hundred, and a thousand = much, and all.
Our flocks are thousands () = goods.
